alias: Bluetooth Low Energy (GATT table and status)
description: Reads the GATT table (the providers make its services and characteristics) and the link's state.

commands.label: Read BLE status
commands.description: Returns the connection state, the negotiated MTU and the number of RX items dropped on a full buffer.

commands.label: Read GATT table
commands.description: Returns every service and characteristic of the GATT table as the next APPLY leaves it.

returns.label: Table
returns.description: u8 service count; per service: u16 UUID, u8 flags (bit 0 primary, bit 1 locked), u8 characteristic count; per characteristic: u16 UUID, u8 flags (as CHAR_CREATE), u16 tx, name (NUL-ended). SYS_BLE.MD "Remote".
